capture.clipSaved.context: Native toast. Length is the duration of the saved replay.

capture.clipSavedUnderSecond.context: Confirmation when a replay file contains less than one second of footage.

capture.clipSavedUnknown.context: Confirmation when a replay file was saved but its duration could not be read.

capture.recordingStarted.context: Native toast after an OBS recording starts.

capture.recordingStopped.context: Native toast after an OBS recording stops.

clips.selectedCount.context: Count of selected cards in the Clips bulk-action toolbar.

clips.showInClips.context: Home card action that reveals the clip in the Clips library.

common.close.context: Dismisses a dialog. Matches OBS's Close message.

notifications.deletedHint.context: Below Notification not found in the reader.

notifications.notFound.context: Heading in the notification reader when an item has disappeared.

notifications.openReleasePage.context: Button opening the GitHub release associated with a notification.

picker.iconImage.context: Windows file picker title for an account or app icon.

picker.importMedia.context: Editor image and GIF picker title.
